First Collection Jumeirah Village Circle

First Collection Jumeirah Village Circle is a 42-storey hotel in JVC District 14, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai.
Updated 29 Jun 2026

donut_small
Overview
First Collection Jumeirah Village Circle is a 42-storey hotel in JVC District 14, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai.
shield
The developer
The project was a development by The First Group.
timelapse
Timeline
Construction began in June 2015 and was completed by June 2020.
pin
Units
The development contains a total of 491 units.
date_range
Key dates
Construction began in June 2015. The estimated opening date was 2021. The project was completed in Jun 2020.
architecture
The architect
The architectural consultant was Norr Group Consultants International Ltd.
construction
The contractor
The main building work was done by China Railway 18th Bureau Group and the foundation work was carried out by Zetas Zamin Teknolojisi.
history_edu
History
The project occupies a plot of land that was initially intended for a different development, Canal Views Towers, which has since been cancelled.
sell
Project value
According to the Land Department, the project was valued at AED 203,168,000 (USD 55.3m).*
* Estimate submitted by the developer prior to construction; final cost may differ.
tips_and_updates
Additional information
stop

This high-rise 4-star hotel consists of 496 guest apartments and hotel rooms in addition to other hospitality amenities.

stop

First Collection Jumeirah Village Circle marks The First Group’s first development in JVC.

stop

For investors this offers a bespoke hotel ownership income programme. The highly efficient central reservation system will ensure high occupancy rates.

stop

Rooms will be available for personal use for two weeks each year.

stop

Prior to opening, The One at Jumeirah Village Circle has was named 'Hotel of the Future' at the id Design Awards and 'Leisure and Hospitality Project of the Year' at the Middle East Architect Awards.

stop

The hotel was initially planned to be flagged as The One at JVC by Ramada Plaza but was changed to First Collection Jumeirah Village Circle on completion.

stop

There will be a range of dining outlets including Santè Ria, a Latino-inspired venue that will serve up South American dishes, Village Bistro serving international buffet, and Terrace Pool with a range of drinks, snacks and BBQ dishes.

Transport & Access

Commute times by car

From First Collection Jumeirah Village Circle it takes roughly 21 minutes to drive to Dubai Mall, 16 minutes to Palm Jumeirah, 18 minutes to Burj Al Arab, and 20 minutes to The Walk JBR.*

Airport proximity

Dubai International Airport (DXB) is roughly 27 minutes' drive and the new Al Maktoum International Airport is roughly 35 minutes' drive.*

* Drive times are calculated by Google Maps and assume fastest route in typical traffic conditions.

Local Schools

First Collection Jumeirah Village Circle has many schools nearby including JSS International School at 1.3 km and Sunmarke School at 1.4 km.

In terms of performance there are 14 schools nearby that have achieved either of two highest government inspection rating of 'Very Good' or 'Outstanding' including Nord Anglia International School Dubai which has a rating of 'Outstanding' and Dubai British School Emirates Hills which also has a rating of 'Outstanding'.

About Propsearch

Propsearch.ae is a Dubai property portal that hosts ads from a number of local real estate agencies. In addition we offer a comprehensive set of community and building guides to help property buyers, renters and investors learn about the areas and buildings that they may wish to live or invest in.

Any enquiries sent regarding a specific property go directly to the estate agent that advertised the property and Propsearch does not play any role in any transactions that may result. Enquires that are sent directly to Propsearch are forwarded to a trusted partner agency that is best suited to handle the enquiry.

Please note that whilst we have a large database of buildings and developments, Propsearch is not a property developer, nor an agent, nor an architect, nor a construction contractor.
